dispositions.topic_text: Exact lexical rules for normalized and permitted delivery names
Failure precedence when a delivery target is or becomes non-regular or symbolic
Meaning and implementation of opening a file without waiting
Whether modification time is truncated before plausibility comparison
Which scan statuses receive a computed source_id
Canonical ISO 8601 serialization and type of marked_at
dispositions.what: The exact ISO 8601 spelling of marked_at and of every other instant.

dispositions.topic_text: Exact responses, codes and precedence for malformed requests and invalid or unknown projects
dispositions.what: The exact status and body of a malformed request, an invalid project id and every refusal.

dispositions.topic_text: Required proof that conflict-copy targets are never read, including race cases
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-19 observes that a conflict copy is never opened, not only the answer and the final files.

dispositions.topic_text: Required proof that ineligible source targets are never read
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-02 observes that a refused path is never opened.

dispositions.topic_text: Required test coverage and proof for preserving all source-folder content and metadata
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-01 covers failed deliveries, folders, names and transient entries in the source folder.

dispositions.topic_text: Separate-process test coverage for cross-process delivery locking
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-12 runs concurrent deliveries in separate processes.

dispositions.topic_text: Required proof that replay performs no writes or state changes of any kind
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-06 observes that a replay performs no write, temporary files included.

dispositions.topic_text: Clock-read acceptance boundary and required read-count tests
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-13 counts clock reads for every refusal before and after the clock and for a replayed mark.
